title: Signal: Yarn lockfile resolves a package from a git remote
scope: A yarn.lock file that declares a Yarn resolution that names a git remote instead of a registry range.
limitations: It matches a Yarn resolution that names a git remote instead of a registry range in the parsed yarn.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A yarn.lock that mentions a Yarn resolution that names a git remote instead of a registry range in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
